becky.subjekt: a slender angelic huntress with long wavy green hair, tanned skin, two white feathered wings, a short emerald-green leather top and green-gold ranger skirt with a white loincloth, bare arms with green bracers, a thin silver rapier in her right hand
becky.angriff: lunges forward and thrusts her thin silver rapier in a quick precise stab, wings flaring open, then springs back to the starting pose

blorgh.subjekt: a hulking undead ogre warrior with pale grey rotting skin, a bald skull-like head with hollow black eye sockets and a gaping mouth, massive shoulders, ragged mossy brown rags, a huge rusty two-handed sledgehammer carried in both hands
blorgh.angriff: raises the huge rusty sledgehammer high overhead with both hands and slams it down with a heavy crushing blow, then drags it back up

knoedelsohn.subjekt: a small bright green dragon standing on two legs, leaf-like scales, large yellow-green bat wings spread wide, a long curling tail, a thin pointed snout with small horns, yellow eyes, no clothing or armor
knoedelsohn.angriff: rears its head back and spits a burst of green acid fire forward from its snout, wings flapping once, then returns to the starting pose

kyori.subjekt: an anthropomorphic orca creature standing upright on a thick finned tail, glossy black and white orca skin with a white belly and eye patches, a dorsal fin on the back, wearing a black leather jacket with silver trim and a red sash, holding a long katana
kyori.angriff: draws the katana in one fluid motion and slashes diagonally across in a swift swordsman's cut, tail bracing, then sheathes back to the starting pose

mictone.subjekt: a dark forest centaur-like tauren with the lower body of a black four-legged beast and the upper body of a pale dark-haired woman, long black horns, tangled black hair, dark green and black bark-like armor, carrying a long wooden bow
mictone.angriff: draws the long wooden bow, aims and looses an arrow forward with a sharp snap of the string, then lowers the bow to the starting pose
